name: Aoife Murphy
title: Lead Graphic Designer
summary: A highly creative and results-driven Lead Graphic Designer with 8+ years of experience specializing in branding, digital media, and print production. Proven ability to lead design projects from concept to completion, managing cross-functional teams and delivering innovative visual solutions that enhance brand identity and market presence.
skills: Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, XD)

bullets: Led a team of 4 designers in developing brand identities and marketing campaigns for over 20 diverse clients, increasing client satisfaction by 15%.
Spearheaded the complete redesign of a major client's digital presence, resulting in a 25% increase in user engagement and a 10% rise in conversion rates.
Managed end-to-end design projects from initial concept through to final production, consistently delivering projects 10% under budget and ahead of schedule.
Mentored junior designers, improving team productivity by 20% through workshops on best practices in UI/UX and motion graphics.
Designed and executed visual content for over 50 digital marketing campaigns, contributing to a 30% growth in client social media reach.
Collaborated with marketing and sales teams to create compelling collateral, which helped secure 15 new client contracts over two years.
Developed and maintained brand guidelines for multiple clients, ensuring consistency across all visual communications.
Created marketing materials including brochures, flyers, and web banners that supported a 15% increase in regional brand awareness.
Assisted in the development of visual concepts for client presentations, contributing to a 5% increase in successful pitches.
Managed graphic assets and digital libraries, ensuring easy access and version control for the design team.

education.degree: Bachelor of Arts in Visual Communications
education.institution: National College of Art and Design (NCAD)

education.degree: Foundation Diploma in Art and Design
education.institution: Dublin Institute of Technology (now TU Dublin)

certifications: Adobe Certified Expert (ACE) in Graphic Design
